title: Durable Pod withdrawal and bounded snapshot recovery

originalUpstreamRun.interpretation: DNS assertions passed; runtime cleanup failed. Recovery is separate evidence and adds no conformance pass.

stoppedStateEvidence.cause: Full snapshots accumulated behind synchronous CRI work while stale assignments continued to create containers. The name-reserved error appeared at shutdown and is not alone evidence of the initial cleanup cause.

changes: Bound pending complete snapshots to highest revision; preserve initial replay; never acknowledge skipped or interrupted applications.
Validate snapshot identity and all Pod assignments before urgent persistence. Persist exact-UID private withdrawal/deletion intent before cancellation or waiting for the reconciler lock.
Register cancellation only for running convergence; release ownership safely on normal completion, failure and asynchronous cancellation.
Drain finite physical urgent deletion before admitting retained creation; retry only the latest incomplete projection and restore the fence from durable state before offline background recovery.
implementation.finalizerIntegration: Release finish-reconciler-urgent-deletion at actual runtime cleanup completion. Retaining an API Pod for user finalizers must not retain this creation fence.
